title: Heat and temperature: molecules of a solid, a liquid and a gas (তাপ ও তাপমাত্রা)
placement: Book page 161, topic 6.1 (তাপ ও তাপমাত্রা): the page has no picture, so this goes next to the paragraphs that ask the student to imagine the molecules ('আমরা যদি আণবিক পর্যায়ে দেখতে পেতাম…': a solid's molecules shake in their places, a liquid's roam among each other, a gas's are free), after the opening paragraph that names তাপশক্তি.
description: Heat and temperature (page 161, topic 6.1) on a lab bench with a slate-blue top in front of a warm beige wall: 60 glossy molecules in a glass container on a steel stand over a row of burner flames, with a thermometer beside it. One button, তাপ দাও, gives heat one step at a time (six steps): a solid's molecules shake about their fixed places, shake more when heated, break free of the forces between them into a liquid (darting about among each other, faster when hotter), then are free of the molecular bonds as a gas, faster still; the molecules go from cobalt blue to vermilion as they warm and the thermometer rises. The words কঠিন, তরল and গ্যাস jump to a state. The panel gives the book's sentence for each step, the formula (তাপশক্তি = অণুগুলোর সম্মিলিত গতিশক্তি) and the rule (তাপ এক ধরনের শক্তি; তাপমাত্রা বলে পদার্থের তাপীয় অবস্থা). Test tab: 5 questions (what the molecules do in a solid, a liquid and a gas shown in the picture; what more heat does to their speed and kinetic energy; the name of the energy from the molecules' motion), every wrong choice a real mistake with its own note. Phone-first, Bangla and English. The units (joule, calorie) are in the sister figure.
